markdown: AI Stats is currently unable to offer Muse Spark 1.1 through the Gateway because Meta Model API access is restricted by location. We will make it available as soon as we can.

Anthropic deprecated `claude-opus-4-1-20250805` on June 5, 2026 and plans to retire it on August 5, 2026. New integrations should move to [`anthropic/claude-opus-5`](/anthropic/claude-opus-5). If you still run Opus 4.1 traffic, use the [Opus 4.1 to 4.8 migration guide](/docs/v1/model-migrations/anthropic-claude-opus-4-1-to-4-8).

Anthropic said on June 12, 2026 that it had to disable Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for all customers to comply with a U.S. export control directive. Requests to this model are currently expected to fail. [Read Anthropic's statement](https://www.anthropic.com/news/fable-mythos-access).
GPT Live 1 is available in ChatGPT Voice for Go, Plus, and Pro users. OpenAI says API support is planned soon, but has not confirmed a stable API model ID, pricing, or AI Stats Gateway availability.
GPT Live 1 Mini is available in ChatGPT Voice for Free users. OpenAI says API support is planned soon, but has not confirmed a stable API model ID, pricing, or AI Stats Gateway availability.

Phaseo shows inferred standard short-context pricing for `gpt-5.5-cyber` based on the published [OpenAI Codex rate card](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001106-codex-rate-card). OpenAI's public [API pricing page](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing) does not currently publish a confirmed standard API price row for `gpt-5.5-cyber`, so these values are informational estimates derived from the Codex credit mapping.

Qwen3.8-Max-Preview is a 2.4T-parameter preview available through Alibaba Token Plan, Qoder, and QoderWork. Qwen says testing in China is ongoing; public API model ID, pricing, context limits, and benchmark results have not been published. [Read Qwen's announcement](https://x.com/Alibaba_Qwen/status/2078754377473601787).
Lyria 3.5 is currently available in Google Flow Music, but Google has not yet documented a public API model identifier. Phaseo routing will remain disabled until an official endpoint is available.
Gemini Robotics ER 1.6 is deprecated and will shut down on 31 August 2026. Migrate to Gemini Robotics ER 2 Preview.

This is an early-access beta deployment backed by DeepSeek's temporary `deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910` endpoint. Provider support may change or end at any time, and the upstream deployment is scheduled to expire on September 10, 2026. Concurrency capacity is extremely low, so requests may fail with capacity or rate-limit errors; do not rely on this endpoint for production workloads.
